commit_message: Move ACP startup off the AI Studio frame thread
pr_title: Keep AI Studio responsive during ACP startup
pr_body:
## Summary

- add a pollable ACP startup worker for provider discovery, process launch, Managed Local startup, ACP initialize, and session negotiation
- route Ask and Build through prepared Agent Host bindings and attach sessions only after startup completes
- preserve negotiated benchmark runtime identity checks before measured ACP work is admitted

A following slice adds explicit startup cancellation, duplicate-Send blocking, visual fixtures, cleanup of the temporary synchronous compatibility seam, and ADR documentation.
